description: This file contains source code implementing integration and transformation logic for Anthropic's API endpoint `/v1/complete`. It defines configuration classes, error handling, response parsing, and response iteration for the Anthropic language models within the litellm framework.

classes.name: AnthropicTextError
classes.description: Custom exception class representing errors from Anthropic's API, capturing status code, message, and request/response details.

classes.name: AnthropicTextConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Anthropic API requests, including parameters like max tokens, stopping sequences, temperature, and supporting methods for environment validation and request transformation.

classes.name: AnthropicTextCompletionResponseIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for processing streaming responses from Anthropic's completion API, parsing chunks into a standardized format.

methods.name: AnthropicTextError.__init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing error details with status code and message, also setting request and response context.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.validate_environment
methods.description: Prepares and validates headers for API requests, ensuring API key presence.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.transform_request
methods.description: Builds the request payload for Anthropic API, generating prompt from messages and merging with config options.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns list of parameters supported by Anthropic's completion API, analogous to OpenAI parameters.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps standard OpenAI parameter dictionary to Anthropic-specific parameters, adjusting optional params accordingly.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.transform_response
methods.description: Parses raw HTTP response from Anthropic, extracts completion text, handles errors, and updates model response and usage stats.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.get_error_class
methods.description: Generates appropriate exception instance based on error message and HTTP status.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig._get_anthropic_text_prompt_from_messages
methods.description: Generates prompt string from message list, possibly using custom prompts if registered.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.get_model_response_iterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator to process streaming responses from the API.

methods.name: AnthropicTextCompletionResponseIterator.chunk_parser
methods.description: Processes a chunk of streamed data, extracting text, finish reason, and other metadata into a standardized chunk object.
